rationale: Fundamental and macro forces strongly conflict with the intraday technical structure. While GIL gapped down 26% on an earnings miss during a severe market sell-off (SPY -3.35%, VIXY +20.29%), intraday price action is bullish, holding near the top of the day's range (91.7%) well above VWAP ($32.80) and the 9-EMA ($33.39). With 10 active/working positions already consuming over 45% of buying power and a relatively wide 11.9 bps spread during the midday lull, there is no high-probability edge in either direction.
